data.display_address: Sidra 1, Sidra Villas, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully extended, this exceptional 3-bedroom + maid's + study villa offers one of the most versatile layouts in Sidra. Set on a generous 5,281 sq ft plot, the home has been designed to maximise both space and functionality while maintaining a seamless flow for modern family living.

One of the villa's standout features is its future flexibility. The extensions have already been completed, allowing the new owner to easily convert the home into a 4-bedroom plus maids plus study—without the need for costly structural work. Whether your family is growing or you simply require additional guest or office space, the home is already designed to evolve with your lifestyle.

Finished to an exceptional standard, the villa is completely move-in ready, eliminating the time, cost and disruption of undertaking your own renovation.

Property Highlights:

* Fully renovated with premium finishes
* Extended to maximise internal living space
* Potential to create a 4-bedroom 
* 3 spacious bedrooms plus maid's room + study 
* Expansive open-plan living and dining areas
* Modern upgraded kitchen
* Beautifully landscaped garden
* 5,281 sq ft plot
* Bright, contemporary interiors
* Motivated seller

Located in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate, Sidra is one of the city's most sought-after family communities, offering parks, swimming pools, walking trails, Dubai Hills Mall, leading schools and world-class healthcare all within minutes.

If you're looking for a turnkey family home that offers luxury today and the flexibility to grow tomorrow, this is a rare opportunity not to be missed.

Arrange your private viewing today and experience the space, quality and potential this exceptional home has to offer.
